## Quality Guardrails (press rubric)

Self-evaluate against every category below before reporting done; revise until the pass criteria hold.

- [ ] **Working Backwards Fidelity** (required): Whether the document genuinely works backwards from customer needs, not forwards from a solution
  - Authentic customer perspective; problem clearly existed before solution was conceived; customer voice feels real
- [ ] **Headline Impact** (required): Whether the headline clearly communicates the primary customer benefit
  - Compelling headline with clear customer benefit; would make a customer want to read more
- [ ] **Customer Problem** (required): How well the customer problem is articulated with authentic voice
  - Vivid problem description with authentic customer quotes; reader can feel the pain
- [ ] **Solution Clarity** (required): Whether the solution and benefits are clearly explained in customer terms
  - Crystal clear solution with concrete, measurable benefits stated in customer terms
- [ ] **Customer Validation** (advisory): Quality of customer quotes and validation
  - Authentic customer quotes with specific success stories that feel real
- [ ] **Simplifying Assumption** (advisory): Whether the document identifies the key insight that makes this achievable
  - Clear simplifying assumption identified that unlocks the solution
- [ ] **Call to Action** (required): Clarity of availability, pricing, and next steps
  - Clear availability, pricing, and specific action steps; bias for action
- [ ] **Readability** (advisory, blocking): Whether the press release is written in plain, accessible language
  - Clear, jargon-free prose accessible to general audience
- [ ] **Economic Sustainability** (advisory): Customer Obsession includes economics (the Kozmo lesson): announcing an experience the business cannot sustain is not doing right by customers
  - The announced experience is plausibly sustainable; pricing or economics are acknowledged and consistent with the promise

Overall pass: every required category passes; findings allowed: 0 critical, 0 high, 0 medium, unlimited low
